Asset: ONE transparent 2D animation sprite sheet with FOUR COMPLETE CHARACTER drawings in a precisely spaced 2 by 2 grid, read top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Square canvas. Four equal square cells, invisible borders, each character fully inside its own cell with 8% empty margins. No labels, panels, text captions, floor, shadows, background, motion streaks or duplicated body parts. Truly transparent alpha.
Image 1 is the identity/style reference: chibi blue gradient wavy hair, ahoge, blue-white whale ears and blue whale tail, orange asterisk hair clip, cream hoodie with caramel bow and orange sleeve asterisks, small flower patch on pocket, tan pleated skirt and white frill, white flower legwarmers, brown Mary Jane shoes. Preserve identity, head/body ratio, rendering style and camera across ALL FOUR drawings. Badge says exactly "Claude" in black on white, orange rim; do not replace it with a flower. Each pose is a complete organically drawn body, two arms/hands and two legs only. No paper cutout articulation. Character's scale and horizontal center identical in every cell.  Supporting Image 2 is a four-time-point contact sheet from the ORIGINAL dsh-pet video. Use it ONLY to understand the action poses, sequencing and interaction; do NOT copy its maid outfit, hairstyle proportions, labels, background or panel design. The replacement character must wear Image 1's cream hoodie, orange details and Claude badge. Leave MORE empty margin than the previous sheets: character occupies only central 75% of EACH cell, ahoge, hands, tail and shoes never touch cell edges.Action 原地重力下蹲压缩. 1 normal standing. 2 lower hips into a half squat by bending knees, arms move forward slightly for balance, head stays proportional. 3 deep comfortable squat with knees bent and feet planted, hands rest near knees, curious face, hair pools softly around body and tail stays behind. 4 push back up halfway, hands lower, returning toward stance. Anatomically coherent drawing of a squat: do NOT uniformly shrink/squash the whole character or change head size. Keep skirt covering body normally.
